description: Measure the current page with Phyll's probe and save the numbers as JSON in the report folder: text contrast against WCAG, the size and position of buttons, icon buttons with no name, dead links, form fields without a label and decoration such as gradients and blur. Returns a short summary; the file holds every number. Use it on each screen you judge.

name.description: Short name for the screen, such as home or flows. It becomes the file name, probe/<size>-<name>.json.

name: probe
